bug_semantics: An authenticated backend user holding any one granular Theme Editor permission could enter Cms\Controllers\Index because the controller authorization was an OR gate, while AJAX code trusted the request-supplied template type without consistently checking the permission mapped to that type. The user could therefore reach pages, partials, layouts, content, or assets outside the granted scope. AssetList was also registered without requiring cms.manage_assets, and its upload path omitted the active-theme validation applied to other mutating asset handlers.
flaw_origin: Single-parent commit 71a5dd67ab9e0d0da7caabd3fb5aaa3d86bb45e5 first added modules/cms/controllers/Index.php and modules/cms/widgets/AssetList.php while registering distinct cms.manage_* permissions. The new controller used a section-wide cms.* gate, unconditionally constructed every template widget, and dispatched request-controlled types without per-type authorization; the new AssetList upload processor lacked validateRequestTheme(). Its direct parent lacks both source paths and the granular permission-bearing implementation, so the vulnerable boundary first exists in this commit. The commit directly adds the affected files rather than moving them and has one parent with no public constituent commits to decompose.
ai_marker: absent — `git cat-file commit 71a5dd67ab9e0d0da7caabd3fb5aaa3d86bb45e5` shows author and committer Sam Georges <sam@daftspunk.com>, the sole message `Welcome to the world, October :-)`, one parent, and no AI/bot identity, Co-Authored-By, Generated-with, or other AI-assistance trailer.
evidence: The disputed field was fix_sha: the primary selected 164c62524e8abc153d09c6c35916278bdb746a2b, while the reviewer selected 5391afa242eba3c476869035b7492e50a262c46b. Re-running `git show 164c62524e8abc153d09c6c35916278bdb746a2b -- modules/cms/controllers/Index.php modules/cms/widgets/AssetList.php` confirms that 164c625 is a substantial first patch: it conditionally registers widgets, adds validateRequestType() to the named controller handlers, and adds validateRequestTheme() to AssetList::onUpload(). It is not complete. `git grep -n -E 'formWidgetAlias|bindFormWidgetToController|makeTemplateFormWidget' 164c62524e8abc153d09c6c35916278bdb746a2b -- modules/cms/controllers/Index.php` and source inspection at lines 145-165 and 890-915 show that index() still accepts AJAX formWidgetAlias, calls bindFormWidgetToController(), takes request-controlled templateType/templatePath, loads or creates that type, and invokes makeTemplateFormWidget() without a type-permission check; the helper at lines 722 onward also has no check. `git show 5391afa242eba3c476869035b7492e50a262c46b -- modules/cms/controllers/Index.php modules/cms/tests/controllers/IndexPermissionTest.php` shows the closing direct source change: validateRequestType($type) is added inside makeTemplateFormWidget(), together with denied/allowed permission regression coverage. `git rev-list --parents -n 1` shows 5391afa has one parent, and `git diff-tree --no-commit-id --name-status -r 5391afa...` reports direct modifications only to Index.php and its test, not a merge, import, aggregate, rename, or move. `git merge-base --is-ancestor 164c625... 5391afa...` succeeds. The assigned first-party advisory data says winter/wn-cms-module <=1.2.12 is vulnerable and 1.2.13 is first patched. `git rev-parse v1.2.12^{commit} v1.2.13^{commit}` resolves b6ac66c5e80ddc9ecd9211c10204cdcee6e14313 and e09c8d3526f3583cb6c3476a021b885088ecd4bd; ancestry checks place neither 164c625 nor 5391afa in v1.2.12 and both in v1.2.13. Tagged-source `git grep` shows v1.2.12 has the unchecked makeTemplateFormWidget binding route, while v1.2.13 contains the handler-level checks and the helper-level check at makeTemplateFormWidget. The only later pre-v1.2.13 change to these files, 598fd8bae3e698f64e4add71b8c0bcd53f2d02ac, merely makes user access null-safe and does not close another authenticated permission path. Parent verification for the BIC: `git rev-list --parents -n 1 71a5dd67...` returns direct parent d412ea685560a3ce7028346d26fd9a6559eb0827, and `git cat-file -e` fails for both affected paths in that parent; `git diff-tree` reports Index.php and AssetList.php as additions in the BIC. BIC-only `git cat-file commit` supplies the no-AI evidence.
reasoning: The reviewer wins the fix_sha disagreement. Commit 164c62524e8abc153d09c6c35916278bdb746a2b fixed the advisory's obvious handlers and asset path but left a request-controlled template type flowing through index() -> bindFormWidgetToController() -> makeTemplateFormWidget() without permission validation. Commit 5391afa242eba3c476869035b7492e50a262c46b places the authorization check in that shared lower-level helper and therefore closes both the missed binding route and every existing helper caller. It is a direct, single-parent source fix, is present at the advisory's first patched version boundary, and is the smallest closing fix rather than a merge or later aggregate. The vulnerable design itself still traces to 71a5dd67ab9e0d0da7caabd3fb5aaa3d86bb45e5, whose immediate parent lacks the affected implementation. Because attribution is restricted to that BIC commit object and it contains no AI signal, the gate-complete verdict remains NOT_AI.
